summary.en: Storm Manja brought strong wind and a new North Sea storm-flood warning, with high water expected around midday.
summary.sw: Dhoruba Manja imeleta upepo mkali na onyo jipya la mafuriko Bahari ya Kaskazini, huku maji yakitarajiwa kupanda karibu adhuhuri.

summary.en: Four Berlin museums opened free on Sunday, with tours, readings and workshops for visitors.
summary.sw: Makumbusho manne Berlin yamefunguliwa bure Jumapili, yakiwa na ziara, usomaji na warsha kwa wageni.

title.sw: Operesheni ya siku saba ya tembo yaanza

summary.en: Same District starts a seven-day operation today to move elephants away from homes and farms, using drones and vehicles.
summary.sw: Wilaya ya Same inaanza leo operesheni ya siku saba kuwaondoa tembo karibu na nyumba na mashamba, kwa kutumia ndege zisizo na rubani na magari.

summary.en: Tanzania has secured Sh3.67 trillion for 424 km of standard-gauge railway from Makutupora to Isaka, part of the Dar es Salaam to Mwanza line.
summary.sw: Tanzania imepata Sh3.67 trilioni kwa kilomita 424 za reli ya kisasa kutoka Makutupora hadi Isaka, sehemu ya njia ya Dar es Salaam hadi Mwanza.

title.en: Five medals at Arusha swim gala
title.sw: Medali tano kwenye mashindano ya kuogelea Arusha

summary.en: Swimmer Nikkie Onovo won three gold and two silver medals at the Arusha International Masters Swimming Championship, with over 300 swimmers taking part.
summary.sw: Mwogeleaji Nikkie Onovo ameshinda medali tatu za dhahabu na mbili za fedha kwenye Mashindano ya Kimataifa ya Kuogelea Arusha, yaliyoshirikisha waogeleaji zaidi ya 300.

question.en: What does "Der Eintritt ist frei" mean?

explanation.en: A: frei here means free of charge, not closed. Grammar: ist = is. Heute = today. Five words: der Eintritt = kiingilio = admission; das Museum = jumba la makumbusho = museum; der Wind = upepo = wind; der Regen = mvua = rain; frei = bure = free. Emin: Leo kuna upepo mkali. = Today there is strong wind. Review: Wie spät ist es? = What time is it? Wir lesen ein Buch. = We read a book. This practice does not prove exam readiness.
explanation.sw: A: frei hapa inamaanisha bure, si kufungwa. Sarufi: ist = ni. Heute = leo. Maneno matano: der Eintritt = kiingilio; das Museum = jumba la makumbusho; der Wind = upepo; der Regen = mvua; frei = bure. Emin: Leo kuna upepo mkali. = Today there is strong wind.
